book.name: Philippi
book.title: Paul Letta Ta Dem Een Philippi

content: We Oughta Dead ta Wesef Jes Like Christ

Een oona life, oona all been jine togeda wid Christ, an dat da courage oona fa true, ainty? Cause Christ lob oona, oona ain haffa warry, ainty? An oona hab God Sperit dey eenside oona, da mek oona one wid um, ainty dough? Oona saary fa one noda, an oona wahn fa do good ta one noda, ainty?
So den, A da beg oona now fa mek me haat heppy fa see oona jine togeda fa be one een de way oona tink, lob one noda een de same way, an all gree togeda wid one haat an one mind fa do de wok.

Mus dohn do nottin jes cause oona wahn fa pit oonasef head ob oda people. Mus dohn do nottin jes cause oona wahn people fa praise oona. Mus dohn hab de big head. Stead ob dat, ebry one ob oona oughta treat de oda people mo betta den esef.
Ebry one ob oona mus dohn jes study bout how fa protec e own ting. Mus study bout how fa protec oda people ting too.
Oona oughta tink een oona haat same like Jedus Christ:

content.text: stillyet e ain tink e oughta try fa stan same like God stan.
Stead ob dat, Jedus gii op all e high place,
an e mek esef fa be jes like a saabant.
E come eenta de wol like a man.
E mek esef tek low an e been ready fa do all wa God tell um fa do,
eben gree fa dead pon a cross.
Cause ob dat, God raise um op an mek um hab high place,
mo high op den all oda,
an God gim de name wa great mo den all oda name.
So dat, fa show hona ta de name ob Jedus,
an all dem wa dey onda dis wol,
all ob um gwine bow down fo Jedus.
All dem gwine tell ebrybody out een de open, say, “Jedus Christ, e de Lawd.”
So ebrybody gwine praise God de Fada.

content: Oona Gwine Shine Like Light Een de Wol

Me fren dem wa A lob sommuch, wa all de time do wa A tell oona fa do, ain jes wen A been dey wid oona, bot now eben mo so wen A ain dey wid oona, mus keep on da do wa A say. Mus try eben mo fa do all oona kin so dat God sabation een oona haat gwine git mo an mo greata. Oona oughta do dat, an know oona sponsable ta God an mus show um hona.
Cause God da wok eenside oona haat so dat oona wahn fa do wa e wahn, an so dat oona able fa do um.
Oona mus dohn grumble bout one noda an mus dohn aagy wensoneba oona da do sompin.

Den oona gwine hab clean haat, an oona gwine be chullun ob God dat ain mix op wid no sin, eben dough oona dey yah een de wol, wid people wa wickity an wa da lib bad life all de time. Den oona life gwine shine fa um like staa light op de sky.

Oona mus tell ebrybody de wod wa da mek um lib fa true. Den wen de day come dat Christ come back, A gwine be heppy fa true bout oona, cause oona life gwine show dat all de haad wok wa A done fa oona sake ain gone fa nottin.
Bot A heppy, an A da rejaice wid all ob oona, eben ef dey kill me an me blood git pour out like a offrin pon de sacrifice dat oona da mek ta God cause oona trus een Christ.
Same way so, oona oughta be heppy wid me.
De Wok ob Timothy an Epaphroditus
A spect fa sen Timothy fa come ta oona tareckly, ef de Lawd Jedus wahn um dat way. Den wen e come back e kin tell me bout oona, an dat gwine courage me.
A ain got nobody else like Timothy, wa cyah bout oona de way e cyah bout oona. E da cyah bout oona fa true.
All dem oda jes da study bout how dey kin hep deysef. Dey ain study bout how dey kin hep fa tell people bout Jedus Christ.
Bot oona know Timothy been show e da do good wok. E da wok wid me jes like e me son an A e fada, fa hep mo an mo people bleebe de Good Nyews.
So den, A hope fa sen Timothy ta oona wensoneba A know wa gwine happen ta me.
An de Lawd mek me bleebe dat tareckly A, too, gwine come ta oona.

A mek op me mind dat A haffa sen me bredren Epaphroditus, fa go back ta oona. E beena do Christ wok wid me an been Christ sodja wid me fa fight fa Christ. E been oona messenja, wa oona sen fa hep me git wa A need.
Epaphroditus wahn fa see all ob oona too bad. E opsot cause oona yeh say e been sick.
Fa true, e been sick down, an e come neah ta det. Bot God hab mussy pon um, an e hab mussy pon me too, so A ain haffa be eben mo sad.
So den, dat mek me wahn eben mo fa sen Epaphroditus ta oona so dat wen oona shim, oona gwine be heppy gin, an den A ain gwine warry sommuch bout um.
Gim haaty welcome an rejaice dat e come ta oona, cause e oona broda een de Lawd. Oona oughta gii hona ta people like dat.
Cause fa de sake ob Christ wok, e pit e life een danja an e mos dead fa mek op fa de hep dat oona ain been able fa gii me.
